metadata.source: Bengaluru Municipal Corporation Citizen Services Dataset
metadata.disclaimer: This is synthetic demonstration data for Indian municipal FAQ chatbot evaluation. It does not represent actual BBMP or Karnataka government policies or real municipal operations.

records.office_location: BBMP Headquarters, Ground Floor, N.R. Square, Sampige Road, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru – 560003
records.working_hours: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 5:30 PM (Closed Sundays and public holidays)
services_offered: Certificate attestation and issuance
Property tax payment collection counters
Permit application receipt and verification
Public document searches and certified true copies
Senior citizen and divyangjan (disability) civic concession cards
records.appointment_policy: Walk-ins welcome with token system. Online appointment booking available on BBMP Citizens Portal to skip the queue.

records.department: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike – Water Supply & Sewerage Board
records.office_location: BWSSB (Bengaluru Water Supply & Sewerage Board), Cauvery Bhavan, 1st Floor, K.G. Road, Bengaluru – 560009
records.working_hours: Administrative Office: Monday to Saturday 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Emergency Pipeline Hotline: 24 hours / 7 days
services_offered: New residential and commercial water connections
Sewage connection sanction and line clearance
Potable water tanker dispatch for shortage areas (₹800 per 5,000 litre tanker for residents)
Water meter testing, inspection, and replacement
Bi-monthly water billing and meter reading disputes
records.complaint_turnaround: Burst pipe / severe leakage response within 4 hours; low water pressure complaints within 48 hours.

records.department: BBMP Revenue Department – Property Tax Division
records.office_location: BBMP Headquarters, Revenue Wing, 2nd Floor, N.R. Square, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru – 560003
records.working_hours: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Cash counters close at 4:00 PM)
services_offered: Property tax assessment and SAS calculation
Annual property tax payment and official receipt (Khata Certificate)
Property ownership transfer mutation records
Property tax assessment revision appeals
Issuance of No-Dues Property Tax Certificates
records.payment_deadlines: First installment due April 30; Second installment due October 31. Early bird rebate of 5% applied if full annual tax is paid before May 31.
records.penalty_rate: 2% simple interest per month on overdue balances after the due date as per BBMP rules.

records.service_name: Public Grievance & Citizen Complaint Redressal Cell
records.office_location: BBMP Headquarters, Room 102, N.R. Square, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru – 560003
records.working_hours: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 5:30 PM; Online BBMP Sahaaya portal & 24/7 IVRS
services_offered: Lodging civic complaints (streetlights, potholes, garbage dumping, stray animal nuisances)
Tracking complaint status via unique Sahaaya Ticket Number
Escalation of unresolved civic complaints to Assistant Commissioner
Citizen satisfaction feedback collection via BBMP Sahaaya App
records.resolution_sla: Streetlight outages: 24 to 48 hours; Garbage clearance: within 24 hours; Pothole patching: 3 to 7 working days; Drainage blockage: 24 hours.

records.service_name: Vital Statistics: Birth & Death Registration Office
records.department: Department of Health & Family Welfare – Civil Registration, BBMP
records.office_location: BBMP Health Department, 2nd Floor, N.R. Square, Bengaluru – 560003
services_offered: Birth registration (must be filed within 21 days of birth, free of cost under RBD Act)
Death registration (must be filed within 21 days with medical cause certificate, free of cost)
Certified copy issuance (₹50 per duplicate certificate copy)
Name correction in birth certificates with judicial affidavit
records.processing_time: 3 to 5 working days for certified copies; instant e-certificate downloads available on Karnataka Sakala portal.

records.office_location: BBMP Works Yard, Peenya Industrial Area, 2nd Stage, Bengaluru – 560058
records.working_hours: Field operations: 24/7 emergency dispatch; Office: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM
services_offered: Pothole repair and bitumen patching
LED streetlight replacement and repair
Stormwater drain (SWD) cleaning and desilting
Pedestrian footpath curb repair and ramp installation
Traffic road markings and civic signage maintenance
records.reporting_channel: Report via BBMP Sahaaya App (1916) or citizen mobile portal with GPS photo attachment.
